metadata.title: נוהל 164 – דיווח ומעקב על מידע בטיחותי במהלך ניסויים רפואיים בבני אדם (Procedure 164: Reporting and Follow-up of Safety Information during Clinical Trials in Humans)
metadata.edition: Procedure 164/01, version 01 · printed 14 June 2018, in force 1 January 2019 · general provisions (calendar days), 5.1.2 to 5.1.5, 5.2.2 to 5.2.5, Table 3 (Hebrew)
metadata.legal_basis: Ministry of Health procedure on safety reporting in clinical trials; the official Hebrew text governs.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
